laptop full-disk encryption
strong password manager setup
multi-factor authentication
BIOS/UEFI and boot security
anti-theft tracking and remote wipe
secure backups
account monitoring and fraud alerts

building a home lab for penetration-testing practice
CTF platforms and deliberately vulnerable machines
how authorized red-team engagements are scoped
lawful incident-response procedures

preserve evidence
change credentials safely
revoke sessions and tokens

file police and fraud reports
